subject: 42 Minneapolis buildings about to come down
body:
Hi Ian,

Every house that comes down in Minneapolis takes its doors, mantels and light fixtures with it. And each one shows up first as a wrecking permit.

So I pulled every wrecking permit from the past year and matched it to the county's year-built records. 42 permits are still open. 18 of those buildings went up before 1940. Four date to 1900, including 734 Tyler St NE, a few blocks from your shop. Most permits name the wrecking contractor, which is the person to call about getting things out first.

https://brickandmortar.dev/for/5a49a5d6/

An open permit doesn't promise the building is still standing, so a drive-by is worth it. The list sorts by age, date, distance or contractor, and it downloads as a spreadsheet. It's free, no strings attached. I run a small data shop here in Minneapolis and wanted to make something useful for a local business.

Best,
Aidan Jude
Brick & Mortar

subject: 38 Minneapolis storefronts that will need their name on the glass
body:
Hi Dan,

Every new storefront needs its name on the glass. The city's permit register shows them before the doors open.

So I pulled every Minneapolis restaurant, shop, dispensary, studio and clinic that got a permit this year to build out street-level space. There are 38. Eight are at final inspection now, the last step before opening. Another 15 are still under construction. A new bakery taking over 4600 Nicollet. Diane's Place expanding on 14th Ave NE. Bellcour's new restaurant going in downtown.

subject: 15 new restaurant kitchens going in around Minneapolis
body:
Hi Palen team,

A new kitchen needs ranges, reach-ins and prep tables. A remodeled one sends working equipment out the back door. You sell the first and buy the second.

So I pulled every Minneapolis restaurant, cafe and bakery build-out, kitchen remodel and hood install permitted this year. There are 65. 15 are brand-new kitchens, like the restaurant going into the old brewery at 6031 Pillsbury and Bellcour's new spot downtown. 11 jobs are at final inspection right now. subject: 110 yards near you where construction just finished
body:
Hi 3 Bears team,

When a garage, retaining wall, addition or new house is finished, the yard around it is often left as dirt and ruts. The city's permit register shows exactly where.

So I pulled every Minneapolis home where that kind of work finished or reached final inspection this past year. There are 356. 110 are within two miles of you on Dight Ave. That's 43 garages, 24 retaining walls, 21 additions, 15 teardowns and 7 new houses.
